prompt:
A hand-painted 2D game asset of a rug made from old sailcloth, a wide flat rectangular rug lying on the ground. Heavy weathered canvas in cream and oatmeal with faded blue stitched seams running along its length and a roped edge. Pale, salt-bleached palette.

Hand-painted 2D game asset. Soft gouache and watercolour with warm brown ink linework, visible brush texture, gentle washes rather than hard cel shading or airbrushing. Storybook illustration style. Flat even lighting from the front with only a soft contact shadow directly underneath. Not photographic, not a 3D render, no glossy highlights, no rim lighting.

STRICT STRAIGHT-ON FRONT VIEW. The object faces the viewer squarely with its LONG SIDE toward the camera. It is NOT rotated, NOT angled, NOT turned, and NOT seen in three-quarter or corner view - you can see its front face and nothing of its left or right ends. The object is perfectly horizontal and bilaterally symmetrical about a vertical centre line. The camera is at standing eye level looking level and straight ahead, so the top surface is seen at a very shallow angle rather than from above. Wider than it is tall.

The object is centred and complete with a small even margin, standing alone on a FLAT SOLID PURE MAGENTA background, hex FF00FF, filling every pixel that is not the object. No floor, no room, no walls, no shadow cast onto the background, no gradient, no texture, no vignette.
